jobs.description: Important: This is a contract/part-time role: 10-20 hrs/week - rate $40-50/hr NOPE is an AI safety company with a unique goal; we do not concern ourselves with bio or cyber-risks or other Hollywood-ized alignment fantasies. We are concerned instead with the massive proliferation of relationships between humans and AI and how this affects our wellbeing and societal fabrics. Billions of conversations between people and AI are accumulating into relationships. This ranges children talking to toys, adults with AI companions, or elderly people engaging with healthcare assistants. We measure real conversations and relationships, and the trajectories of risks involved, and publish what we find, so platforms (and society) can decide when and how to act. We build ML models, track incidents, analyze new regulations, and run evaluations constantly on both raw LLMs and deployed AI. We believe you cannot foster safe and aligned AI without proprer governance and scrutiny into AI as it is truly deployed and productized. The eval space in AI is currently heavily oriented to raw LLM evals unfortuntely. We seek to change that. We seek to hold AI labs and products to account for the harms they produce. Our mission is malleable and always changing, and we search for people who seek to help define that. The Social Comms role : We are doing quite a lot but are very limited on social-and-community-driving capacity. The incidents and regulations we track, the whitepapers, plus our evaluations, are all lacking our commentary and voice. We want to increase our social media presence significantly and start to be a more active participant in the global conversation around AI safety and alignment. As our social-comms person you'd take artifacts and research we produce and weave them into a consistent, human presence on the prevalent social channels: deciding what gets posted, writing it, engaging with the researchers, journalists, builders and policymakers already wrestling with these questions. You're a pundit, optimist, skeptic, researcher and writer all rolled into one.Â The measure of your work would be whether the right people are actually engaging: researchers, builders, journalists, policymakers, and the ordinary users who sense something is off. No growth-hacking or engagement bait please. We would rather stay small and authoritative than sound like a brand. The work is async, any timezone, and you'd have direct access to the passionate team and to everything we publish before it's public. You will have a significant say and authorship of our blog (nascent stages still), linkedin, other social accounts, public spaces, and private community spaces that you recommend. Anything relevant to our work. You'd be a great fit if You care deeply about what AI is doing to human relationships and social norms; you're concerned and curious. You understand how LLMs work at an abstract level and the flaws they have. You've run or grown popular social accounts before. You write like a person, and you don't lean on AI to think or post for you. You can read a piece of research and find the three lines people will actually care about. jobs.title: Scrum Master / Delivery Enabler (m/w/d) - KI-gestützte Softwareentwicklung
jobs.description: Du begeisterst dich für agile Delivery und willst die sich wandelnde Rolle des Scrum Masters im KI-Zeitalter aktiv mitgestalten? Unsere Mission: Delivery Enablement als starke, zukunftsfähige Rolle etablieren und Projekt-Teams auch im KI-Wandel wirksam unterstützen. Wir teilen Wissen, gestalten unsere Rolle gemeinsam weiter und bringen unterschiedliche Stärken ein. Unsere Projekte reichen von einzelnen Entwicklungsteams bis hin zu internationalen Programmen in Branchen wie Automotive, Energie und Public Sector. Hier kommst du ins Spiel: Als Delivery Enabler übernimmst du Verantwortung für eine Rolle im Umbruch, führst interdisziplinäre Teams durch den KI-Wandel und trägst maßgeblich dazu bei, Delivery Enablement zu einer starken, zukunftsfähigen Funktion weiterzuentwickeln. Deine Aufgaben Teams stärken: Du arbeitest eng mit deinen Entwicklungsteams zusammen: Du beseitigst Hindernisse, entwickelst konstruktive Arbeitsweisen weiter und förderst so effektive Teamstrukturen. Stakeholder steuern: Du bringst die unterschiedlichen Interessen von Team, Kunde und MaibornWolff aktiv zusammen und sorgst so für einen klaren, effizienten Entscheidungs- und Kommunikationsfluss. Delivery absichern: Anhand konkreter Kennzahlen machst du Wirkung und Wertbeitrag deiner Rolle sichtbar. Du schaffst ein gemeinsames Verständnis von Zielen und Erwartungen, beseitigst Hindernisse und adressierst mögliche Risiken frühzeitig. KI-Agenten integrieren: Du befähigst dein Team zur optimalen Einbindung von KI-Agenten und Tools und hast die damit verbundenen Prozess- und Kommunikationsverschiebungen im Blick. Du begleitest Teams und Kunden souverän durch KI-bedingte Change Prozesse. Bereich mitgestalten: Gemeinsam mit deiner Delivery Enabler-Gilde entwickelst du unser Rollenverständnis weiter, teilst dein Wissen und treibst relevante Themen voran. Wenn du möchtest, engagierst du dich zusätzlich als Mentor:in in der Mitarbeitendenentwicklung oder in anderen internen Aufgaben. Dein Profil Ausbildung: Du hast idealerweise ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Wirtschaft oder IT - entscheidend ist für uns jedoch deine reale Projekterfahrung. Praxiserfahrung: Du bringst mindestens 3-5 Jahre relevante Projekterfahrung als Scrum Master, Agile Coach oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle innerhalb der Softwareentwicklung mit. Du kennst sowohl die Arbeit auf Teamebene als auch die Koordination über mehrere Teams hinweg, idealerweise ergänzt durch Erfahrung in interkulturellen Kontexten. Methodenkompetenz: Du beherrschst agile Frameworks wie Scrum oder Kanban und bestenfalls auch Skalierungsmodelle wie SAFe, Nexus oder LeSS. Vielleicht hast du sogar bereits Erfahrungen mit OKRs, Flight Levels oder im Value Stream Mapping gesammelt. Tools: Du nutzt KI-Anwendungen routiniert und zielgerichtet für deine eigene Arbeitseffizienz. SOE delivers consultancy projects for strategic customers in defense, energy, space, finance, retail and other industries. Our two founders both held C-level roles at leading German robotics ventures. They have spent years bringing advanced technology onto real shop floors, and now they're hiring the founding team. The role You'll build the software that makes sense of what happens on a manufacturing floor. Our platform processes this data to power analysis and automated workflows. We work AI-first. Our coding agents know our platform and our engineering practices, and you'll use them every day. You're still the engineer, though. You'll review every line, understand what it does, and test it properly. That frees you to focus on the application, the industrial domain, and the quality of the system. We care about what you can show, how fast you learn, and whether you take ownership. Seniority and years of experience matter less. What you'll do Own features end to end: understand the problem, choose the approach, then build, test, ship, and follow up Get to know the existing codebase in depth, including its architecture, dependencies, data flows, and failure modes Write code with AI tools and review each change line by line for correctness, maintainability, security, and impact on the wider system Build meaningful unit, integration, and end-to-end tests and wire them into CI Test against messy real-world data, using recorded streams, representative datasets, and simulated devices. Cover missing or delayed measurements, duplicate or out-of-order events, invalid values, and dropped connections Reproduce failures, fix them, and add regression tests so they don't return. Make sure tests reflect the intended behavior, and challenge the assumptions in the implementation Build and improve backend services, APIs, and data pipelines for industrial analytics, knowledge retrieval, and automated workflows Learn how our users and their factories work, so you can spot the right improvements and make good engineering calls Help wherever it's needed: integration, deployment, documentation, and technical investigation. jobs.title: Senior Security Operations Engineering Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description: It all starts with the mission: NVISO is here to protect European society from potentially devastating cyber attacks. This means we offer cyber security services to private and governmental organizations to help them better prepare for, prevent, detect and respond to cyber security incidents. All of this is built on four fundamental values that define who we are: We are Proud, We Break Barriers, We Care and No BS! Tasks As Senior Security Operations Engineering Manager (m/w/d) located in Germany , you grow NVISO's Security Operations Engineering (SOE) business and lead its senior delivery capability. You are responsible for commercial growth, delivery performance and functional management of the experienced SOE population. SOE delivers consultancy projects for strategic customers in defense, energy, space, finance, retail and other industries. Our work covers SOC management, SOC design, SIEM and detection engineering, SOC automation and vulnerability management. You have a strong SOC background, but your main focus is to win work, grow customers and help teams deliver it well. You report to the Solution Lead for Security Operations Engineering and work closely with the CEN Service Line Lead and partners. Typical responsibilities include: Owning the SOE revenue target and sales pipeline, covering new business, expansion of existing accounts and follow-on work; Building customer relationships and leading proposals, SOWs, RFP responses and tenders, with partners approving final commercial commitments; Working with team leaders to manage delivery quality, customer satisfaction, staffing, utilisation, profitability and delivery risk; Acting as a senior escalation point for complex customer and delivery matters, and contributing to selected high-end projects; Providing functional leadership to team leaders and SOE consultants with six or more years of relevant experience in their SOC field of expertise; Coaching experienced consultants and contributing to performance, career, staffing, development, retention and recruitment decisions; Bringing customer and delivery feedback to the Solution Lead to support the development of the SOE portfolio. Requirements You hold citizenship in one of the 32 NATO member states or the Austrian citizenship; Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field, or equivalent professional experience; At least eight years of experience in cyber security, with a strong foundation in security operations, SOC consulting or a closely related field; At least three years of experience in business development, sales, account management or a commercially oriented consulting role; Demonstrable experience growing cyber-security services through new business, customer expansion and long-term account development; Experience shaping and delivering complex professional-services engagements, including proposals, SOWs, RFP responses or tenders; Strong understanding of SOC operating models, SOC management, SIEM engineering and detection engineering; Experience managing consulting delivery, including customer expectations, quality, staffing, utilisation, profitability and delivery risk; Experience leading, coaching or functionally managing experienced cyber-security professionals and/or team leaders; Fluent business English and professional fluency in the relevant local language(s). Benefits At NVISO, we care. We are committed to offering you a highly competitive remuneration package including financial and non-financial components: Working and learning from the best people in the European cyber security industry. jobs.description: Role:  Head of Data Engineering Location:  Manchester based office – Hybrid working Package:  £98k OTE   PHMG is continuing to develop and mature its data capability, focusing on modernising our data platform and enhancing the way we work. This creates further opportunities to leverage data more effectively, allowing us to better serve our customers and colleagues. As part of this continued development, we are looking to strengthen our Data Engineering capability and maximise the value from the wealth of data held across the organisation.  To support this vision, we are seeking a Head of Data Engineering. This pivotal role will lead an established Data Engineering team, supporting their development while strengthening engineering practices, technical standards and ways of working across the function. The successful candidate will foster a culture of technical excellence, collaboration and continuous improvement.  This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced data engineering leader to help develop our data engineering community of practice, define data standards across the organisation and be part of the team delivering and evolving PHMG's Data Strategy.  The role: What you will do:   Lead, manage and develop the Data Engineering team, building capability, resilience and strong ways of working. Own PHMG's core data platform, architecture, data warehouse and associated pipelines, ensuring solutions are scalable, reliable, maintainable and cost-effective. Own Data Engineering delivery, ensuring work is appropriately designed, prioritised and delivered to agreed standards. Establish and embed strong engineering practices across source control, CI/CD, testing, code review, documentation, monitoring and error handling. Work closely with the wider Data team to translate the Data Strategy and business priorities into an effective engineering roadmap and delivery plan. Work closely with IT, Infrastructure and other engineering teams on architecture, integrations, migrations and platform decisions. Identify and evaluate opportunities to improve the performance, reliability and efficiency of PHMG's data capability, including the use of emerging technologies. This is an exciting role for an experienced data engineering leader who has:   Demonstrable experience leading, developing and managing Data Engineering teams. A strong track record of designing and delivering enterprise-scale data platforms, solutions and architectures. A thorough understanding of modern ETL/ELT practices and experience designing scalable, reliable and maintainable data pipelines. Advanced working knowledge of SQL and Python. Experience working with modern cloud data platforms such as Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, Databricks, Redshift or BigQuery. Experience within the Microsoft data ecosystem would be advantageous. Strong understanding of modern engineering practices including source control, CI/CD, automated testing, code review, monitoring and observability. Strong experience of data modelling for reporting and analytics, using tools and approaches such as dbt or equivalent. Strong understanding of data quality, governance, security and data management best practices. Experience managing engineering delivery using agile ways of working. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain technical decisions, risks and trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences. Nice to have experience:   Experience integrating data with operational systems, including reverse ETL into platforms such as Salesforce. Understanding of the Data Science / Machine Learning lifecycle and MLOps.

jobs.title: Agentic Compiler Engineer
jobs.description: ABOUT KOG Kog builds a co-designed inference stack for real-time AI agents on standard datacenter GPUs, spanning model architecture, inference engine, compilers, and low-level GPU kernels. On the model side, we developed Laneformer 2B and Delayed Tensor Parallelism (DTP), a Transformer architecture that overlaps communication with useful computation and weight streaming. On the systems side, the Kog Inference Engine runs this stack on standard AMD and NVIDIA datacenter GPUs. Kog generates 3,500 tokens/s per request on 8 AMD MI300X GPUs and 2,100 tokens/s per request on 8 NVIDIA H200 GPUs, in FP16 at batch size 1, with quantization and speculative decoding disabled. Our next major project is AGCO, our agentic compiler. AGCO is designed to optimize LLMs across different GPUs and optimization targets, including very fast inference. The team has 10 people, including 9 engineers and researchers and 4 PhDs. Test it at playground.kog.ai. Read the technical details on the Kog Labs blog. WHAT YOU WILL WORK ON You will work directly on AGCO. The goal is to build a system that can explore ways to optimize LLM execution, generate changes, compile them, check correctness, run them on real hardware, measure the results, and use this feedback to guide the next optimization. You will contribute to areas such as: Compiler and IR design for representing and transforming LLM computations. Optimization passes, lowering, and code generation. Search methods for exploring different implementations and execution strategies. Verification and correctness checks for generated changes. GPU execution, profiling, and performance optimization. LLM inference across operators, memory, parallelism, and communication. Optimization loops that connect generated changes to measurements on real GPUs. One direction we are exploring combines an IR, a verifier, a compiler, and a search optimizer. We plan to start with focused problems, build working prototypes, and extend the system from what we learn. Your main area will depend on your experience, skills, and interests. You may focus more on compilers, GPU systems, or LLM inference while working closely with people across the full stack. WHAT WE LOOK FOR We look for engineers with deep technical expertise and original work in at least one area relevant to AGCO. Relevant experience includes: Compiler engineering, including optimization passes, IRs, lowering, code generation, LLVM, or MLIR. GPU programming with CUDA, HIP, Metal, Vulkan, or similar technologies. GPU performance work involving kernels, memory, synchronization, profiling, or hardware behavior. LLM inference engines and performance optimization. Attention, MoE, parallelism, communication, or other systems-level parts of LLM execution. Formal verification, equivalence checking, SAT/SMT, or related methods. Systems that generate, search, test, benchmark, or optimize code automatically. We care about what you personally built and the technical decisions behind it. Strong candidates can explain the problem, their approach, the alternatives they explored, and how they measured the result. We review technical work during the process. This can be public code, an upstream contribution, a paper, a thesis, a technical project, or a detailed write-up based on work you can share. WHAT WE OFFER You will join a small team building AGCO as a core part of Kog's technology. Work at the intersection of compilers, GPU systems, and LLM inference. Direct access to engineers working across the full inference stack. A fast loop from an optimization idea to compilation, execution, verification, and measurement on real GPUs. The opportunity to go deep in your strongest technical area while expanding into the other parts of the stack. High ownership over technical decisions and systems that will shape how Kog optimizes LLM inference. This role is based in Paris, and we are looking for candidates who can relocate to Paris and work closely with the team. Find Jobs in France on Arbeit

jobs.title: Photonic Packaging Engineer
jobs.description: About Quandela Quandela is a global leader in photonic quantum computing, developing hardware and software technologies to build scalable and energy-efficient quantum systems. With more than 140 people, we develop our own stack, from semiconductor quantum emitters and photonic integrated circuits to quantum control systems, software and algorithms. Our ambition is to build large-scale fault-tolerant quantum computers. Reaching this scale requires increasingly reliable, manufacturable and integrated photonic hardware, making our Integrated Photonics team a key part of this journey. About this position: You will join our Integrated Photonics team, working across Massy and Palaiseau at the interface between PIC design, characterization, packaging and system integration . We are looking for a hands-on Photonic Packaging Engineer to take ownership of our packaging activities, improve existing processes and help make our PIC integration more reliable and reproducible. Your first priority will be to contribute to ongoing packaging activities, develop and improve assembly processes, and troubleshoot integration challenges alongside our PIC design and characterization teams. As you grow into the role, you will also have the opportunity to develop new packaging approaches, coordinate technical projects and contribute to building more structured and scalable packaging capabilities. Why this role matters: Today, packaging activities involve several members of our team. Having a dedicated engineer will help us accelerate ongoing developments, improve the reproducibility of our processes and strengthen the connection between PIC design, characterization and system integration. As our PIC platforms evolve, your work will also contribute to developing new integration approaches and preparing our packaging processes for future scale-up. Requirements What will you do: Develop and improve photonic packaging processes: • Take ownership of ongoing packaging activities and improve existing processes. • Develop optical coupling, precision alignment and fiber-array attachment methods. • Work on component assembly, bonding and electrical interconnections. • Address mechanical and thermal integration challenges. • Test new approaches, troubleshoot issues and improve process reproducibility. Qualify and improve packaged devices: • Build and test prototypes to validate packaging approaches. • Define performance metrics, tolerances and acceptance criteria. • Characterize packaged PICs alongside the PIC Characterization team. • Troubleshoot optical, electrical and mechanical integration issues. • Establish repeatable procedures and technical documentation. Connect packaging with PIC design: • Work closely with PIC Designers to anticipate packaging constraints. • Translate assembly challenges into practical design-for-packaging guidelines. • Collaborate with characterization and system-integration teams to improve packaged device performance. Build the packaging capability: • Collaborate with external packaging partners and equipment suppliers. • Improve existing equipment, assembly methods and internal capabilities. • Explore new packaging technologies and integration approaches. • Support automation to improve accuracy, reproducibility and throughput. • Progressively lead technical projects and contribute to future scale-up. How you'll grow: 0–3 months → Get familiar with our PIC platforms, existing packaging processes and integration challenges. Contribute to ongoing activities and start taking ownership of selected technical tasks. 3–6 months → Take increasing responsibility for packaging processes, develop and test improvements, and contribute to making our assembly methods more reliable and reproducible. 6–12 months → Lead packaging development activities within your area of expertise, strengthen our qualification and documentation practices, and contribute to new packaging approaches and technical projects. Longer term → Depending on your experience

jobs.title: Network Developer
jobs.description: Senior Network Developer About Share Share is the global marketplace for bandwidth. We aggregate telco infrastructure across Africa (fiber routes, subsea capacity, data centers, cloud on-ramps) into a single intelligence layer. That lets ISPs, hyperscalers and AI companies get connectivity where they need it in seconds, not months. Today, bandwidth is bought and sold through slow, private, one-off deals, with almost no price transparency. We're replacing that with one neutral exchange: an API on top of real infrastructure, with prices set by actual supply and demand. It's already live across East Africa, with thousands of kilometers of fiber, 12 infrastructure providers, 10 data centers, and around 8 million people served. The Role Our network is the foundation of the product. Every route a customer provisions through our API has to exist, perform and stay up on real hardware. We're hiring a Senior Network Developer to design and build that network as software: a distributed, multi-provider fabric that engineers change through code, not by logging into devices. You'll own the network architecture end to end. That covers our BGP edge (transit, peering at KIXP and LINX, private interconnects with hyperscalers), the backbone, and the PoPs and data centers we're adding across the continent. You'll set the standards our network is built to, which partner ISPs connecting to us will inherit. As we grow, you'll also help build the network engineering team. What you'll do Design the backbone and PoP architecture as standard, repeatable building blocks, from edge to data center, so we can add capacity and new markets without redesigning each time. Drive our move to Segment Routing and a clean IP architecture, including IPv4 reuse, IPv6, and how customer and internal address space coexist. Build on disaggregated white-box hardware (Edgecore with IP Infusion OcNOS today), and make the hardware and software calls that keep us fast and affordable. Turn operations into software. That means a source of truth (Nautobot), templated config (Jinja), and CI/CD with validation, staged rollouts and rollback for every change. Build the telemetry and observability that show what the network is really doing. Use AI where it actually helps: anomaly detection, automated triage, and auto-remediation with a human in the loop. Own availability. Limit how much any failure can affect, mitigate first and diagnose second, and turn post-mortems into fixes in the system. Work with our software team on the API and provisioning layer that exposes the network to customers, and with partner ISPs' engineers on the hand-off. Help hire and develop the engineers who'll run this with you. Our Ideal Candidate 8+ years building and operating large networks at a hyperscaler, CDN, internet exchange, carrier or ISP. Deep BGP at scale: route policy, communities, RPKI, traffic engineering, peering and transit. Strong data center and backbone design. You know Clos/EVPN-VXLAN fabrics and MPLS or Segment Routing, and when each makes sense. Hands-on with white-box or disaggregated networking, including choosing hardware and knowing where the silicon limits you. You treat the network as code. You write automation yourself (Python or similar), and you've built or run the pipelines, source of truth and telemetry that make that safe. You've owned availability for something that couldn't go down, and can walk us through a real incident: what broke, how you found it, and what you changed. AI-native in how you work. You've built with these tools, not just used them, and you have a view on where they help in operations and where they don't. You think like an owner. You bring ideas, not tickets, and you want to help build a team, not just a network. A clear, direct communicator who's comfortable with partners' engineers and with our founders. Nice to have Experience at an internet exchange, or running peering at scale. Open networking stacks like SONiC, OcNOS or FRR, or contributions to them

jobs.title: Network Developer
jobs.description: Senior Network Developer About Share Share is the global marketplace for bandwidth. We aggregate telco infrastructure across Africa (fiber routes, subsea capacity, data centers, cloud on-ramps) into a single intelligence layer. That lets ISPs, hyperscalers and AI companies get connectivity where they need it in seconds, not months. Today, bandwidth is bought and sold through slow, private, one-off deals, with almost no price transparency. We're replacing that with one neutral exchange: an API on top of real infrastructure, with prices set by actual supply and demand. It's already live across East Africa, with thousands of kilometers of fiber, 12 infrastructure providers, 10 data centers, and around 8 million people served. The Role Our network is the foundation of the product. Every route a customer provisions through our API has to exist, perform and stay up on real hardware. We're hiring a Senior Network Developer to design and build that network as software: a distributed, multi-provider fabric that engineers change through code, not by logging into devices. You'll own the network architecture end to end. That covers our BGP edge (transit, peering at KIXP and LINX, private interconnects with hyperscalers), the backbone, and the PoPs and data centers we're adding across the continent. You'll set the standards our network is built to, which partner ISPs connecting to us will inherit. As we grow, you'll also help build the network engineering team. What you'll do Design the backbone and PoP architecture as standard, repeatable building blocks, from edge to data center, so we can add capacity and new markets without redesigning each time. Drive our move to Segment Routing and a clean IP architecture, including IPv4 reuse, IPv6, and how customer and internal address space coexist. Build on disaggregated white-box hardware (Edgecore with IP Infusion OcNOS today), and make the hardware and software calls that keep us fast and affordable. Turn operations into software. That means a source of truth (Nautobot), templated config (Jinja), and CI/CD with validation, staged rollouts and rollback for every change. Build the telemetry and observability that show what the network is really doing. Use AI where it actually helps: anomaly detection, automated triage, and auto-remediation with a human in the loop. Own availability. Limit how much any failure can affect, mitigate first and diagnose second, and turn post-mortems into fixes in the system. Work with our software team on the API and provisioning layer that exposes the network to customers, and with partner ISPs' engineers on the hand-off. Help hire and develop the engineers who'll run this with you. Our Ideal Candidate 8+ years building and operating large networks at a hyperscaler, CDN, internet exchange, carrier or ISP. Deep BGP at scale: route policy, communities, RPKI, traffic engineering, peering and transit. Strong data center and backbone design. You know Clos/EVPN-VXLAN fabrics and MPLS or Segment Routing, and when each makes sense. Hands-on with white-box or disaggregated networking, including choosing hardware and knowing where the silicon limits you. You treat the network as code. You write automation yourself (Python or similar), and you've built or run the pipelines, source of truth and telemetry that make that safe. You've owned availability for something that couldn't go down, and can walk us through a real incident: what broke, how you found it, and what you changed. AI-native in how you work. You've built with these tools, not just used them, and you have a view on where they help in operations and where they don't. You think like an owner. You bring ideas, not tickets, and you want to help build a team, not just a network. A clear, direct communicator who's comfortable with partners' engineers and with our founders. Nice to have Experience at an internet exchange, or running peering at scale. Open networking stacks like SONiC, OcNOS or FRR, or contributions to them

jobs.title: Network Operation Engineer
jobs.description: Network Operations Engineer 1. About the role Share is the global marketplace for bandwidth. We aggregate telco infrastructure into a single layer and give ISPs, hyperscalers, and AI companies a clean path to deliver connectivity into every home and business across Kenya and the continent. Behind that marketplace is a real network: a BGP edge peering with Tier 1 transit, hyperscalers, and local exchanges, an MPLS backbone, aggregation and access gear, and the systems that watch all of it. For the partners who run on us, the network is the product, and the NOC is where they feel it. A clean shift is a partner who never knew anything happened. That is the bar. We are early and the team is small, so we cannot afford a pair of hands that only knows how to escalate. We need a capable network engineer who can stand a shift, resolve real faults without waking anyone, and then keep building the network while East Africa sleeps: propagation and peering checks, health passes across the estate, config changes through to merge, tickets off the board, automation that takes the next repetitive job off everyone's plate. The watching is the floor of this role, not the ceiling. The NOC you would be joining is not a legacy one. We are building it as an AI assisted operations environment from the ground up. The forwarding plane runs on open source routing and forwarding software, every device configuration lives in Git, and an LLM layer sits on top of the live network state. When something moves, that layer reads the telemetry, correlates it against the topology and the config history, and puts a probable cause and a candidate fix in front of the engineer on shift. The point is not to replace your judgment. It is to collapse the time between an alert firing and you knowing where to look, so mean time to repair is measured in minutes. You sit inside that system. You use it, you push back on it when it is wrong, and what you catch that it misses is part of how it gets smarter. As we build automation out across the NOC, you are not just a consumer of the tooling. You help write it. 2. What you'll do Watch, and know what you're looking at. Sit on our monitoring stack (Zabbix and Grafana dashboards, flow telemetry, alerting) and actually read it. Learn what normal looks like so abnormal jumps out at you: a BGP session that dropped, a link that went down, latency climbing on a path, a capacity threshold breached, a partner suddenly pushing or pulling nothing. Troubleshoot and resolve. This is where you earn your seat. Confirm the alert is real, gather the facts, and localise the fault: one peer or many, us or upstream, a real outage or a monitoring blip. The assistive layer surfaces a likely diagnosis and a suggested fix, the config history is right there in Git, and the runbooks are live. Your job is to read all of it critically, decide what is actually true, and close out what you can on your own. Every ticket you resolve yourself is one our senior people did not get pulled out of deep work, or out of bed, to deal with. Keep the network healthy, not just alive. A quiet shift is not an idle one. Run the proactive passes: check that routes are propagating the way they should, that RPKI and filter chains are doing their job, that peering and transit sessions are clean across the edge, that no PoP is drifting toward a capacity wall. Catch the slow degradations that never trip an alert. The day team should inherit a network in a known good state. Build and automate. The repetitive parts of this job should not stay repetitive. Write the scripts that turn a manual check into a scheduled one. Push our config automation forward (Jinja driven generation, NAPALM or NETCONF/gNMI against the devices) so changes ship from data, not from memory. When the assistive layer keeps missing the same thing, that is a candidate for automation, and you are well placed to build it during the hours nobody else is online. Move the work forward. You are part of the network team

jobs.description: <h2>Who is Artefact?</h2> <p>Artefact is a next-generation strategy and data consulting firm dedicated to transforming organisations through data and AI. We combine the rigour of top-tier strategy consulting with deep expertise in data, digital and analytics to help clients achieve tangible business impact.</p> <p>With 2,500+ consultants, data scientists and engineers, we work with global leaders such as Samsung, L’Oréal, Orange and Sanofi. You will:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Strategy Development:</strong> Work with client leadership teams to address high-stakes questions. How can AI reshape our business model? How should we govern and organise for data? Which strategic programmes deliver the most impact?</li> <li><strong>Structured Problem-Solving:</strong> Break complex challenges down into decisions a client can act on, combining consulting rigour with a working knowledge of what current AI can and cannot actually do.</li> <li><strong>Solution Design:</strong> Turn a business question into a solution shape — what data it depends on, what kind of platform or product it should sit on, and what “good” looks like once it is built. You will build trusted relationships, communicate recommendations with clarity, and keep the work aligned to what the client is actually trying to decide.</li> <li><strong>Knowledge &amp; Practice Building:</strong> Contribute to the growth of Artefact's Zurich office by shaping new offerings, creating intellectual capital - frameworks, thought pieces, benchmarks - and taking part in business development.</li> </ul> <h2>Candidate Profile</h2> <p>We are looking for someone who can hold a technical position and a commercial one at the same time. jobs.title: Senior Quality Manager
jobs.description: About the role Imagine owning the quality backbone of an aerospace company moving at full speed. While innovation accelerates around you, you ensure every design and every process meets the highest standards without slowing the momentum. As the Engineering Quality Manager, you will ensure that our engineering Organisation (including the Design Organization (DO)) maintains compliance with applicable standards and best practices (like EASA Part 21 Subpart J, EN9100). You’ll lead the development and oversight of our quality system, manage design supplier qualification and monitoring, drive internal and external audits and continuous improvement across all design, qualification and certification activities. At Destinus , we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations. What You´ll Do Be responsible for establishing, documenting, developing and managing the Quality System and for ensuring that it continues to comply with regulatory requirements and business needs. Support and guide our Engineering departments in the definition and implementation of efficient processes. Oversee design supplier qualification, categorization, and ongoing performance monitoring. Maintain and enhance the quality system, including document control, change management, and compliance monitoring Monitor compliance of internal processes with established industry standards and certification authority requirements (such as EN9100, EASA Part 21J and required military standards). Plan, conduct, and document internal and external audits in line with established processes. Track and follow up on audit findings and corrective actions. Collaborate with stakeholders and external auditors (e.g., EASA, MoD), and cross-functional teams to ensure compliance and quality standards are met. Requirements What You’ll Need 7+ years in military or civil aviation or aerospace quality and compliance, or other highly quality driven industries such as automotive, energy with hands-on experience in the aviation industry Experience with supplier quality management. Track record in leading quality investigations, undertaking root cause analysis, developing corrective action plans, and ensuring the effectiveness of actions undertaken. Audit training/certification or experience setting up  ISO 9001, AS9100, AQAP2110 quality systems required. Familiarity with EASA Part 21 Subpart J and industry certification standards (e.g., DO-178C, DO-254, STANAGs). Strong communication, analytical, and cross-functional collaboration skills Who You Are You are naturally detail obsessed but never lose sight of the bigger picture. You combine regulatory sharpness with practical engineering judgment and you know when to challenge and when to enable. Calm under pressure, you bring structure to complexity and clarity to ambiguity. You are assertive without ego, collaborative without compromising standards. When something is not compliant, you speak up. When a process can be better, you improve it.   Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Staff Cyber Security (w/m/d)
jobs.description: Über IONOS Bei IONOS verwalten wir nicht nur Server, wir prägen mit unseren Lösungen die digitale Zukunft für über 6,2 Millionen Kundinnen und Kunden weltweit. Als Europas führender Hosting-Anbieter und Pionier für unabhängige Cloud-Lösungen bauen wir eine Infrastruktur der nächsten Generation: von souveränen Cloud-Architekturen und hochperformanten GPU-Clustern bis hin zu integrierten KI-Automatisierungstools. Was uns antreibt: Digitale Entscheidungsfreiheit für Europa und echter Impact für kleine und mittlere Unternehmen (KMU) sowie Großunternehmen. Wir arbeiten in agilen Teams, setzen auf transparente Strukturen und glauben daran, dass Exzellenz und Innovation nur mit echtem Teamgeist entstehen. Bereit für Deinen nächsten Schritt? Werde ein Teil von IONOS und wachse mit uns. Als Cyber Security Engineer (m/w/d) spielst Du eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Sicherstellung der Sicherheit unserer Anwendungen und Systeme. Du bist verantwortlich für die Identifizierung von Sicherheitsrisiken, die Durchführung von Sicherheitsbewertungen und die Entwicklung von Sicherheitslösungen, die unsere Betriebs- und Entwicklungsteams bei der Umsetzung von resilienteren und robusteren Anwendungen unterstützen. Diese Position bietet Dir die Möglichkeit, an herausfordernden Projekten zu arbeiten und mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams zusammenzuarbeiten, um Best Practices im Bereich der Cyber- und Informationssicherheit zu implementieren. Aufgabenbereich Zusammenarbeit mit technischen Teams zur Integration von Sicherheitskontrollen und -maßnahmen in den Softwareentwicklungslebenszyklus und in sichere Betriebsabläufe Durchführung von Sicherheitsbewertungen, wie Penetrationstests, Bedrohungsmodellierungen und Konzeptüberprüfungen Entwicklung und Betrieb von technischen Sicherheitstools zur Sicherstellung zentraler Sicherheitskontrollen wie Schwachstellenmanagement oder die Einhaltung von Vorschriften bei selbstverwalteten Arbeitsstationen Planung und Durchführung gezielter Schulungen zu Anwendungs- und Infrastruktur-Sicherheit Qualifikationen Fundierte Erfahrung im Bereich der Informationssicherheit und intrinsische Motivation, Dein Wissen ständig aktuell zu halten Verständnis für moderne, agile Produktentwicklung und praktische Erfahrung mit DevSecOps-Konzepten Erfahrung mit technischen Sicherheitsprüfungen aller Art (White-Box und Black-Box), idealerweise in regulierten und zertifizierten Umgebungen wie KRITIS, PCI-DSS Sicherer Umgang mit mindestens einer Programmiersprache, idealerweise Python und/oder Java, sowie Erfahrung mit modernen virtuellen Maschinen und Container-Umgebungen Teamplayer durch und durch, der stets mit gutem Beispiel vorangeht. Du fühlst Dich wohl dabei, Projekte und Stakeholder auch in stressigen Situationen effizient zu führen Starke Problemlösungsfähigkeiten, gute Englischkenntnisse, Qualitätsbewusstsein, Eigenverantwortung und die Fähigkeit, in einem internationalen Team zu arbeiten Benefits Hybrides Arbeitsmodell. Flexible Arbeitszeiten durch Vertrauensarbeitszeit. An einigen Standorten eine bezuschusste Kantine und verschiedene kostenfreie Getränke. Moderne Büroflächen mit sehr guter Verkehrsanbindung. Diverse Mitarbeiterrabatte für Aktivitäten und Produkte. Mitarbeiterevents wie Sommer- und Winterfeiern, sowie Workshops. Zahlreiche Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten. Verschiedene Gesundheitsangebote, wie Sport- und Gesundheitskurse. Hinweis zur Bewerbung Wir wertschätzen Vielfalt und begrüßen alle Bewerbungen – unabhängig von z. B. Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion, Behinderung, Alter sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität, körperlichen Merkmalen, Familienstand oder einem anderen sachfremden Kriterium nach geltendem Recht. jobs.title: Social Media Managerin / Content Creatorin (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Du willst nicht nur Social Media managen, sondern selbst das Gesicht einer Marke werden? BuddySIM macht mobiles Internet auf Reisen einfach. Mit unseren eSIMs können Reisende in über 190 Ländern direkt online gehen: 100% ohne Roaming-Stress, SIM-Kartenwechsel oder komplizierte Tarife. Jetzt wollen wir unsere Marke auf Social Media auf das nächste Level bringen. Dafür suchen wir eine Persönlichkeit, die Lust hat, vor der Kamera zu stehen, Menschen anzusprechen und gemeinsam mit uns Content zu entwickeln, der auffällt. Du wirst eines der Gesichter von BuddySIM auf TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts und weiteren Plattformen. Deine Aufgaben Du stehst regelmäßig selbst vor der Kamera und repräsentierst BuddySIM auf unseren Social-Media-Kanälen. Du entwickelst kreative Formate, Reels, TikToks und wiederkehrende Content-Serien. Du gehst offen auf Menschen zu und führst beispielsweise spontane Interviews, Straßenumfragen oder Reise-Challenges durch. Du beobachtest Trends und erkennst früh, welche Formate, Sounds und Themen Potenzial haben. Du entwickelst Ideen, Hooks, Storylines und Skripte. Du produzierst authentischen Content von der Idee über den Dreh bis zum fertigen Video. Du begleitest Events, Reisen, Kooperationen oder Aktionen mit der Kamera. Du baust gemeinsam mit uns eine wiedererkennbare Social-Media-Persönlichkeit für BuddySIM auf. Du analysierst, welche Inhalte funktionieren, und entwickelst unsere Formate kontinuierlich weiter. Du managed Kooperationen mit anderen Creatoren:innen. Das solltest du mitbringen Du bist kommunikativ, spontan und kannst Menschen mit deiner Art mitnehmen. Außerdem wäre ideal, wenn du: dich vor der Kamera wohlfühlst und authentisch auftreten kannst, offen und selbstbewusst auf fremde Menschen zugehst, TikTok, Instagram und aktuelle Social-Media-Trends wirklich verstehst, ein gutes Gespür für Humor, Storytelling und interessante Hooks hast, kreative Ideen nicht nur vorschlägst, sondern auch direkt umsetzen möchtest, eigenständig arbeiten und Verantwortung für eigene Formate übernehmen kannst, grundlegende Erfahrung mit Videoaufnahme und Videoschnitt mitbringst, Lust auf Reisen und internationale Themen hast, sehr gutes Deutsch sprichst; Englisch ist ein Plus. Ein klassischer Lebenslauf oder ein bestimmter Studienabschluss ist für uns deutlich weniger wichtig als Persönlichkeit, Kreativität und dein Gefühl für Social Media. Was dich bei BuddySIM erwartet BuddySIM ist ein wachsendes Travel-Tech-Unternehmen aus Deutschland. Wir wollen keine austauschbare Corporate-Kommunikation produzieren, sondern Social Media machen, das Menschen tatsächlich anschauen möchten. Bei uns bekommst du: sehr viel kreativen Freiraum, die Möglichkeit, eigene Formate von Grund auf aufzubauen, kurze Entscheidungswege und schnelle Umsetzung, direkten Austausch mit dem Gründerteam, moderne Tools und Equipment für deine Content-Produktion, ein junges, dynamisches Umfeld, die Möglichkeit, bei Reisen, Events und besonderen Aktionen dabei zu sein, und vor allem die Chance, eine sichtbare Persönlichkeit unserer Marke zu werden. Wer perfekt zu uns passt Vielleicht produzierst du bereits selbst TikToks oder Reels. Vielleicht bist du die Person in deinem Freundeskreis, die problemlos mit jedem ins Gespräch kommt. Vielleicht hast du bisher noch nie professionell Social Media gemacht, weißt aber ganz genau, warum manche Videos Millionen Views bekommen und andere niemanden interessieren. Entscheidend ist für uns nicht dein perfekter Lebenslauf. Interesse? Dann schick uns keinen Roman. Sende uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf oder dein LinkedIn-Profil und gerne direkt ein kurzes Video, in dem du dich vorstellst. Bonus: Schick uns eine Idee für ein TikTok oder Reel, das du für BuddySIM drehen würdest. Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Head of Finance (m/f/d)
jobs.description: At Superchat, we're rebuilding how businesses talk to their customers. The phone call, the contact form, the support ticket: all of it is being replaced by messaging and AI. We're building the platform that runs underneath. Founded in 2020, Superchat has become the platform of choice for 10,000+ businesses worldwide , from globally recognized brands like Allianz, Auto1, Enpal, Danone, and GASAG to the small businesses, dental practices, and one-person startups that need to look bigger than they are. Today, millions of messages flow through Superchat every single day . We started as a unified inbox: one place for every channel a customer might pick, WhatsApp, email, SMS, Instagram. Then ChatGPT happened, and the second chapter began: AI agents that respond across chat, email, and voice at the quality of the best human teams. We're 100 people , profitable , and have raised €18M in funding (last round 4.5 years ago, we've been growing on our own money since). Headquartered in Berlin. In this role you own all of finance at Superchat end to end and report directly to the founders. When the board or our investors have a question about the numbers, you're the one who answers it. You'll take over our financial model and turn it into something the whole company can steer by. You'll own accounting through to the P&L, run forecasting and liquidity planning, and lead the annual audit. Who We Want 7+ years of finance experience. You know the full cycle first-hand, from closing to forecast to board reporting. Closing and audit expertise. You independently own monthly and annual closings under HGB, including revenue recognition and accruals, and you coordinate the annual audit with our external auditors through to completed financial statements. Expert financial modelling. You build driver-based, integrated three-statement models from scratch and you document them so that others can operate them too. Forecasting. You've owned full budget and forecast cycles, you bring together top-down targets and bottom-up input from team leads, and you treat forecast accuracy as a measurable figure that has to improve. Business partner. You deliver a reasoned recommendation, not just the numbers and you follow up on whether it gets implemented. Experience with investors and the board. You've prepared and presented board materials, and you've been through a financial due diligence - ideally on the company side. Bridges finance and startup culture. You bring the rigour a finance function demands, while working productively with fast decisions and shifting priorities. Appetite for automation. You actively look for ways to take manual work out of the close and the reporting cycle, so the team's time goes into analysis rather than assembly. Strong communicator. You translate complex financial data into clear narratives for stakeholders without a finance background, and you're confident in the room with founders, board and investors. Fluent German and English, written and verbal. Who We Don't Want Manages the status quo. You run an inherited function competently, but you don't develop it further. Reports instead of advising. You deliver numbers without drawing a recommendation from them, and consider the job done once the report is sent. Treats the model as personal property. You build something only you can operate with undocumented logic and manual overrides nobody else can follow. Uncomfortable in front of investors. Looking for predictability. You need stable priorities and permanently fixed responsibilities. jobs.title: Network Operation Engineer
jobs.description: Network Operations Engineer 1. About the role Share is the global marketplace for bandwidth. We aggregate telco infrastructure into a single layer and give ISPs, hyperscalers, and AI companies a clean path to deliver connectivity into every home and business across Kenya and the continent. Behind that marketplace is a real network: a BGP edge peering with Tier 1 transit, hyperscalers, and local exchanges, an MPLS backbone, aggregation and access gear, and the systems that watch all of it. For the partners who run on us, the network is the product, and the NOC is where they feel it. A clean shift is a partner who never knew anything happened. That is the bar. We are early and the team is small, so we cannot afford a pair of hands that only knows how to escalate. We need a capable network engineer who can stand a shift, resolve real faults without waking anyone, and then keep building the network while East Africa sleeps: propagation and peering checks, health passes across the estate, config changes through to merge, tickets off the board, automation that takes the next repetitive job off everyone's plate. The watching is the floor of this role, not the ceiling. The NOC you would be joining is not a legacy one. We are building it as an AI assisted operations environment from the ground up. The forwarding plane runs on open source routing and forwarding software, every device configuration lives in Git, and an LLM layer sits on top of the live network state. When something moves, that layer reads the telemetry, correlates it against the topology and the config history, and puts a probable cause and a candidate fix in front of the engineer on shift. The point is not to replace your judgment. It is to collapse the time between an alert firing and you knowing where to look, so mean time to repair is measured in minutes. You sit inside that system. You use it, you push back on it when it is wrong, and what you catch that it misses is part of how it gets smarter. As we build automation out across the NOC, you are not just a consumer of the tooling. You help write it. 2. What you'll do Watch, and know what you're looking at. Sit on our monitoring stack (Zabbix and Grafana dashboards, flow telemetry, alerting) and actually read it. Learn what normal looks like so abnormal jumps out at you: a BGP session that dropped, a link that went down, latency climbing on a path, a capacity threshold breached, a partner suddenly pushing or pulling nothing. Troubleshoot and resolve. This is where you earn your seat. Confirm the alert is real, gather the facts, and localise the fault: one peer or many, us or upstream, a real outage or a monitoring blip. The assistive layer surfaces a likely diagnosis and a suggested fix, the config history is right there in Git, and the runbooks are live. Your job is to read all of it critically, decide what is actually true, and close out what you can on your own. Every ticket you resolve yourself is one our senior people did not get pulled out of deep work, or out of bed, to deal with. Keep the network healthy, not just alive. A quiet shift is not an idle one. Run the proactive passes: check that routes are propagating the way they should, that RPKI and filter chains are doing their job, that peering and transit sessions are clean across the edge, that no PoP is drifting toward a capacity wall. Catch the slow degradations that never trip an alert. The day team should inherit a network in a known good state. Build and automate. The repetitive parts of this job should not stay repetitive. Write the scripts that turn a manual check into a scheduled one. Push our config automation forward (Jinja driven generation, NAPALM or NETCONF/gNMI against the devices) so changes ship from data, not from memory. When the assistive layer keeps missing the same thing, that is a candidate for automation, and you are well placed to build it during the hours nobody else is online. Move the work forward. You are part of the network team

jobs.title: AI Systems Engineer (f/m/d)
jobs.description: Who is Sonar? Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code verification and governance, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable. Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code. We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like: SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform. SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair. SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective. Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE: Committed to our customers and community. Obsessed with quality. Deliberate in our decisions. Effective as one team. With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you. Position description The Business Technology team is composed of passionate technologists who are fully engaged in delivering the best products that help teams deliver their best work. We are focused on reducing friction and getting the most value from solutions to enhance outcomes. We want to expand our Business Technology landscape to manage more systems in a predictable way that accounts for scalability, resilience, and performance. This role sits at the intersection of AI-native operations, enterprise platform engineering, and IT service management. You will own how Sonar designs, builds, and operationalizes AI-augmented systems across its internal technology ecosystem — engineering AI agents and connectors, automating workflows end-to-end, and integrating our enterprise tool stack, with Jira Service Management and the Atlassian suite as one core platform among several. While Jira Service Management and the broader Atlassian suite form a core part of your platform footprint, your scope extends well beyond it: you will build and maintain integrations across our enterprise tool stack, engineer automation pipelines that eliminate manual work at scale, and operationalize AI-native capabilities (Enterprise Apps connectors, Claude MCP integrations, Rovo agents) that put Sonar ahead of the curve in AI-driven internal operations. Your success will directly enable every internal team at Sonar to work faster, smarter, and with less friction — and will give leadership real-time visibility, consistent governance, and a platform that scales effortlessly with the company's global growth. What you will do You are confident in owning and evolving a multi-platform internal technology ecosystem for a fast-growing, multi-site, multinational organization. You bring deep expertise in building AI-native systems and automations, and you are equally at home administering and evolving ITSM platforms — especially Atlassian — that anchor Sonar's internal operations. You bring proven, multi-year experience in: AI Systems & Agent Engineering (primary focus): Designing, building, and operationalizing AI-native capabilities across Sonar's internal stack — Claude MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations, custom Claude skills, Rovo agents, and Enterprise Apps connectors. jobs.title: Automation Engineer, Wet Lab
jobs.description: Role summary: At Differential Bio, our mission is to unlock the potential of the bioeconomy by fixing how biological R&D and scale-up are done . Today, bioprocess development is slow, expensive, and limited by the economics of lab hardware. A typical system runs 4, 8, or 24 bioreactors in parallel, and a single run can cost anywhere from hundreds to several thousand dollars. Our ambition is different: 100 parallel bioreactor runs at around $10 per run. Why does that matter? Because radically reducing the cost per insight changes what is possible. Instead of running a handful of carefully selected experiments, we can generate dense, standardized datasets across thousands of conditions. That data is at the core of Differential Bio. First, we automate high-throughput data generation. Then we use our proprietary datasets to train AI models that understand how bioprocesses behave across conditions and scales - with the long-term goal of building a digital twin of fermentation at any scale . We have already built two end-to-end automated fermentation pods that operate continuously and generate experimental data every week. Being vertically integrated all the way down to the physical lab has proven to be a major advantage for us. Now we are hiring the first role dedicated entirely to lab automation . You will take over this domain from our founder and CTO, Martin, report directly to him, and own how our automation platform develops from here. This is, in many ways, the role we always wished existed : high autonomy, genuinely difficult engineering problems, the freedom and resources to solve them properly, and a mission worth the hard work. This is not a role for someone who wants to select the next six-figure laboratory automation system from a catalogue. We want someone who looks at a €500,000 solution and asks: Why does this cost €500,000? What problem are we actually solving? And could we achieve the same outcome - or a better one - for a fraction of the cost and at 10x the scale? Sometimes the answer will be an established lab instrument. Sometimes it will be an industrial robot, a €50 sensor, a 3D-printed part, and some clever engineering. Your opportunity is to help us completely rethink how lab automation is done and build the infrastructure that makes biological R&D dramatically faster and cheaper. Key responsibilities: Own lab automation at Differential Bio end-to-end, from creating individual components to developing complete new automated fermentation systems, including technical decisions, experimentation, suppliers, and budget. Drive our ambition to dramatically increase experimental density while reducing the cost per experiment and cost per insight. Translate wet-lab workflows into reliable, scalable automation together with our scientists, software engineers, and ML engineers. Make pragmatic build vs. buy vs. modify decisions instead of defaulting to expensive, closed laboratory automation platforms. Prototype and build yourself: fermentation pods and small bioreactors, using 3D printing & our workshop. Evaluate and integrate robots, liquid handling systems, and emerging automation technologies, working directly with manufacturers to adapt or co-develop around our requirements. Continuously improve reliability, throughput, maintainability, and cost as our automation platform scales. Qualifications: We care more about how you solve engineering problems than about a specific degree or career path. You should: Have evidence of excellence: 4+ years of experience in lab automation, robotics, or other automation projects involving real hardware - or an equivalent track record of serious hobby projects where you have built, modified, automated, and debugged physical systems yourself. Be a tinkerer : someone who enjoys opening the box, understanding how something works, modifying it, and building something better when necessary. You don’t need to be an engineer, but you do need to be toolsy – using AI to automate repetitive work, improve processes and build better ways of working. jobs.description: About Nous Nous is an AI agent that takes some of the load of life: making good decisions and acting for people in areas where they're not the experts, or aren't paying enough attention. We started with bills, where we're already saving households thousands, and we're now expanding into new categories. Think Amazon starting with books. It's working. 20x year-on-year growth makes us one of the fastest-scaling startups in the UK, and an NPS of +70 (higher than Apple) says our users love it. On top of bill optimisation, we've just launched two more products: insurance, where we're the first in the UK to get regulatory approval to run the full discovery-and-purchase journey as an agent (not just hand you a link). And subscription management, where we use Open Banking to actively cancel unwanted subscriptions for people, rather than just draw them a pretty graph. We're a certified B Corp, and that's how we hold ourselves to the mission rather than just talking about it. We've stacked the deck: a founding team with multiple exits, and investors including the founders of Monzo, Wise, Booking.com, lastminute.com, Onfido, Funding Circle, Tide and Habito. The problems are hard, and that's the point. Talk is cheap, and that goes for agents too. To have real impact, an agent has to break out of the sandbox and act in the real world, where there are consequences. That means solving all the thorny, frustrating, genuinely interesting problems the real world throws up. How we build (worth reading before the role) Most companies split the thinkers, the doers and the builders. We don't. Something special happens when they're the same people: a small team that builds and owns the tools for its own problems understands those problems from the inside. So the rule at Nous is simple. The person who feels the problem should be the one who builds the fix. This isn't brand new. A sharp generalist could always wire something together with no-code and low-code tools to solve a problem. The catch was the ceiling: those tools were far more limited than real code, so you hit a wall the moment the problem got interesting. Unless you had superhuman levels of stubbornness and a high tolerance for using tools for things they really weren't designed for. What's changed is that ceiling. With AI tooling and a lot of context, you're now building much closer to real code, and shipping it on the live product. You can change how our WhatsApp agent handles a tricky conversation, dig through Open Banking data to find money we should be saving people, prototype a feature, or automate a process that used to eat someone's week. And you're not doing this around engineering, you're doing it alongside engineers. Engineers build the safe surfaces you ship on (the tools, the infrastructure, the context APIs, the guardrails), and they're who you pull in when you reach the edge of what's safe to touch alone. None of that works without a particular kind of person: not a software engineer, but someone who builds like one. The role You'll own a product surface and make it better, end to end, without waiting for an engineer to do it for you. The clearest version of this already exists on the team. Ben joined as a PM, not an engineer. Engineering set him up with the right infrastructure and a context API, and now he ships changes to Nora (our customer-facing WhatsApp agent) himself, pulling people in only when he's blocked. Worth being upfront: we've never hired for this profile directly before. The people doing it today grew into it here (Ben from product, Gen from ops) once we set them up with the tooling and context to build. You'd be the first we bring in, so expect the role to shift a bit as we figure out what works. Depending on where you're strongest and where we need you most, the first surface might be: Nora and our AI agents. If this problem space resonates, please read on. PS: I’ve actually written this page with my hands; this is not AI-written content! About Nous Roughly 90% of UK households are overpaying on their bills. Nous is an agent to absorb complexity out of households, saving them money and time. Our mission is to make people’s lives simpler and fairer, starting with the 30 million households here in the UK, and soon far beyond. Nous is growing fast, and it’s working. 20x YoY growth makes us one of the fastest scaling startups in the UK. And NPS of +70 (higher than Apple) shows that our users love it. We started with bills because ‘change begins at home’ - it’s a naturally low-interest, messy area of our lives which most of us don’t want to think about. Similar to how Amazon started with books as their first category to go after. ‘Talk is cheap. Action is what really matters’. What we’re building is an agent to take some of the load of life, make good decisions and act for us in areas we can’t or don’t want to act on our own. For an agent, advice is cheap. Action is the product. And action means solving problems in the messy real world . A note on product There’s ‘product’ as in the web application that guides our users through the complex world of bills and household admin. It acts as their interface to our management service, as well as all the behind the scenes capabilities needed to orchestrate and deliver that service - actually saving our users money and time. Try it here: app.nous.co/signup (it’s free!) Then there’s ‘product’ as experienced by our users - which is a service which makes life simple and fair. To deliver this we’ve built a set of powerful capabilities that let us run and improve the service efficiently at scale: agentic communication, multimodal data extraction, orchestration for long-running operational processes, recommendations, our own agentic harness, and more. We compose these into executable workflows that deliver real outcomes for members, like switching someone to a better energy deal without the hassle. Today, we help manage six areas of household spending: Energy, Mobile, Broadband, Mortgage, Personal finances (e.g., managing subscriptions), and Insurance. But we’re just getting started. Behind the scenes, we’ve built the technology (we call it Blueprints) that acts as rails for us to quickly expand on the breadth and depth of our service lines. You’ll be a hands-on technical leader on some of the highest-leverage areas of our codebase, from building out agentic capabilities to scaling our service logic. jobs.title: Laboratory Technician
jobs.description: About Us Basecamp Research is building frontier AI for therapeutic design. We believe the future of medicine lies in reprogramming the body to repair itself, and we design the models and the medicines to teach it how. Our EDEN models are trained on BaseData, the world's largest proprietary genomic dataset, with over 10B genes collected through partnerships in more than 30 countries across all seven continents. This gives our AI models access to genetic diversity that doesn't exist in public databases, and enables EDEN to design cell and gene therapies, enzymes, and peptides directly from information about a disease. Our pipeline of EDEN-designed therapeutics, beginning with in vivo cell therapy, is advancing towards clinical development. In September 2026 we closed an oversubscribed $140M Series C led by S32, with participation from NVIDIA, Anthropic's Anthology Fund, Catalio, European Tech Collective, Firebrand River Capital, King Philanthropies, NATO Innovation Fund, NVentures (NVIDIA's venture arm), Redalpine, Rockefeller Foundation, Singular, Sovereign AI and True Ventures. We have offices and labs in London and Boston, we partner with biopharma companies and academic institutions worldwide, and our work has been recognised by Fast Company's Top 10 Most Innovative Companies in Biotech, the FT-backed Sifted AI100 list of Europe's leading AI startups as well as Barclays Eagle Labs Ones to watch, AI100. At Basecamp Research, we pride ourselves on being a lean collaborative and global team with extremely specialist and unique skills. Our biologists, engineers, ML scientists and field explorers are united by a sense of adventure and the belief that AI, biology and data, will result in new medicines for patients who have few options today. The Role & Key Responsibilities The hands of the Trillion Gene Atlas. You will keep samples moving through our extraction, normalisation, and library preparation pipeline - precisely, reliably, and at pace. Run the daily sample processing pipeline. Execute DNA extraction, normalisation, and library preparation workflows across soil, faecal, and other environmental sample types - following validated SOPs with precision and consistency at high throughput. Operate and maintain laboratory automation. Work with automated liquid handling systems (including Myra9) and other platforms to process samples at batch scale. Perform routine maintenance, troubleshoot instrument issues, and flag deviations from expected performance. Maintain accurate records in LIMS. Log all sample processing steps, QC data, and observations in Benchling LIMS in real time. Ensure full traceability of every sample from receipt through to sequencing dispatch. Perform QC checks and flag anomalies. Carry out quantification, quality checks, and standard analytical assays at key pipeline stages. Identify out-of-specification results, escalate appropriately, and contribute to root cause investigations. Support R&D protocol testing. Assist the R&D team with comparative experiments, kit testing, and protocol optimisation runs as new methods are validated for production. A practical, hands-on contributor to continuous improvement. Maintain a safe, organised lab environment. Uphold high standards of lab hygiene, reagent management, and safety compliance including CL2 working practices. Help keep the lab stocked, organised, and ready to run at scale. Required Skills and Experience Hands-on laboratory experience in a molecular biology or life sciences setting - academic, commercial, or both Practical experience with DNA extraction from biological or environmental samples using kit-based and automated methods Comfortable working at high throughput with strong attention to detail - precise pipetting, consistent technique, reliable record-keeping Experience using LIMS or equivalent electronic lab notebook for sample tracking and data recording Ability to follow SOPs accurately, identify deviations, and escalate clearly and prompt

You will turn vast, heterogeneous, often downright strange biological data into annotated, trustworthy resources the rest of the company and our models can build on. Design approaches for biology that doesn't fit standard schemas, curate the data to be model-ready, and benchmark honestly to tell real improvement from noise. Prototype methods and validate on real, messy data at scale. Own light orchestration to prove or disprove an approach, then hand off to dedicated teams who take it to full production scale. Reach for newer ML methods where they are the right tool for annotation, labelling, or mining, and fold them into your approach cleanly. Keep the data trustworthy. Provenance, edge cases, and data integrity are part of the craft, not an afterthought. Help build outward-facing tools where the opportunity arises. jobs.description: About Niantic Spatial At Niantic Spatial, we're building the future of physical AI. Powered by a proprietary database of over 30 billion posed images, our groundbreaking mapping technology unlocks a new dimension of interaction and spatial intelligence that helps both humans and machines better understand, represent, navigate, and engage with the real environment. Our reconstruction technology captures environments with geometric accuracy and extreme detail from any standard camera, and our Visual Positioning System delivers precise positioning almost anywhere in the world. We serve customers across robotics, the public sector, and energy and industrial markets - building for the 80% of economic activity that takes place beyond our screens. About the Role Niantic Spatial makes the physical world computable, helping people and machines collaborate safely by aligning how they understand reality. One of the fundamental problems we're helping autonomy teams and engineers overcome is the sim-to-real gap for visual-spatial understanding. We're applying our team's decades of experience encoding the world precisely as it is at Google Maps, Google Earth, and Niantic Labs to build the scalable real-to-sim stack for embodied AI. Niantic Spatial's R&D Team in London is seeking a Research Scientist to push the frontiers of Spatial AI, advancing our Large Geospatial Model as a dedicated member of the Embodied AI group. You will invent and develop algorithms and systems that sit at the cross-section of computer vision, machine learning, AI, graphics, and robotics. We're passionate about discovery, so we're looking for scientists who want to learn, publish, teach, and deploy every new invention. What You'll Do Develop New Spatial Representations - Develop new spatial representations that embodied AI can learn from, train in, and act on. Advance Real-to-Sim Pipelines - Advance real-to-sim pipelines connecting real-world observations, 3D reconstruction, simulation, and robotic policy learning. Solve Emerging Spatial Problems - Solve emerging problems that relate to spatial intelligence, 3D scene representation, training data, model efficiency, and interactive systems. Take Capabilities Through to Evidence - Take new capabilities through to evidence: what changed for the policy, not only what changed in the reconstruction. Build Prototypes - Build proof of concept prototypes, initially for internal use, where some will need to run at production scale on customer data. Collaborate Across Research and Product - Collaborate closely with researchers, engineers, and product partners to bring novel models to production. Publish Your Work - Publish and present your work. What You'll Bring A PhD in computer vision, robotics, graphics, machine learning, or a related field, or equivalent research experience, with a publication record at top venues. Substantial expertise in robotics or embodied AI, including experience in sim-to-real transfer, domain randomization, policy evaluation, and simulation-based learning. Deep experience with 3D scene representations: Gaussian splatting, neural fields, meshes, point clouds, or implicit representations. You have applied generative or diffusion models to 3D data, such as scene completion, inpainting, relighting, or novel view synthesis from sparse capture. You have worked on 3D semantics, open-vocabulary scene understanding, or scene graphs. Proficiency in Python and Deep Learning libraries such as PyTorch. GPU or graphics programming experience, such as custom CUDA kernels, shaders, or differentiable rendering. A track record of contributing to widely used open-source research codebases. Nice to Have Proficiency in C++. Compensation & Benefits Base salary range of £103,500 to £202,500. Compensation also includes an annual bonus, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package.
